full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned archival photograph looks down over a riverside avenue lined with tall old buildings and moored boats. The view is elevated, opening across a pale river on the left and a close row of many-story facades on the right. In the upper distance, the water bends into haze, while faint building blocks on the far bank become little more than soft gray-brown silhouettes. The right-hand buildings rise almost to the top edge, their repeated window grids, mansard roofs, chimneys, and irregular roofline supplying fine architectural texture. Small shop awnings interrupt the ground-floor frontage near the lower right. Between the buildings and the river, a narrow quay angles from the foreground toward the distant center. A few tiny walkers and a dark vehicle-like shape occupy the road, giving the scene scale without crowding it. Lamp posts and slender poles punctuate the quay at intervals. Boats crowd the river edge: dark barges sit along the middle left, with tall thin masts rising against the light water, and a larger open-deck boat anchors the lower-left foreground. The water is calm and pale, retaining only soft reflections beneath the vessels. Stone paving and the quay wall form diagonal lines that guide the eye toward the foggy bend. Fine photographic grain, slight softening, and darkened corners mark the aged print. Diffuse overcast light arrives through the pale sky, flattening cast shadows while giving the building faces enough tonal separation to remain legible. The palette stays within warm cream, taupe, charcoal, and faded brown. The overall composition balances the dark detailed building mass and boats against a wide luminous river, preserving the quiet distance of an old city view.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色调的旧式摄影从高处俯看一条河畔大道，旁边排列着高大的旧楼与停泊船只。升高的视点左侧展开浅色河流，右侧则靠近一排多层立面。远处上方，水道弯入雾霭，对岸隐约的建筑群只剩柔软灰棕剪影。右侧楼宇几乎升至上边缘，重复的窗格、折坡屋顶、烟囱和参差天际线提供精细的建筑肌理。右下附近，几片商铺遮篷打断底层街面。楼宇与河流之间，一条窄岸路从前景斜向远处中央。少量渺小行人和一个深色车辆般的形体占据道路，标示尺度，却不让场景拥挤。路灯与细杆以间隔点缀岸路。船只沿河边密集停泊：深色驳船排在左侧中景，高而细的桅杆衬着浅色水面升起，一艘更大的敞甲板船稳住左下前景。水面平静而浅亮，只在船下留有柔和反射。石铺地面与堤岸墙形成斜线，引导视线通向朦胧的河湾。细摄影颗粒、轻微柔化与变暗的角落标示出老照片表面。阴天漫射光从浅色天空进入，压平投影，同时让建筑正面仍有足够的明度分离。调色始终处于暖乳白、灰褐、炭色和褪色棕的范围。整体构图以深色而细致的楼宇和船群平衡宽阔发亮的河流，保留旧城景观安静的距离感。
style_prompt_en: The archival photographic look uses a narrow sepia range of warm cream, faded brown, taupe, and charcoal. Diffuse light keeps cast shadows weak, while tonal differences between large masses preserve a clear reading of depth. Fine repeated lines and small dark marks gather in one part of the frame; a broad pale field gives them room and sets up an asymmetrical balance. Diagonal recession and gradually softened contrast lead from crisp foreground details into misty distance. Grain, slight blur, and darkened print edges create an aged material surface without hiding the underlying structure. Reflections remain subdued, and highlights are creamy rather than brilliant white. The overall effect is patient and documentary, with atmosphere, repeated geometry, and a carefully weighted light-dark division doing the expressive work.
style_prompt_zh: 这种旧式摄影观感使用暖乳白、褪色棕、灰褐与炭色的狭窄棕褐色域。漫射光使投影微弱，而大形体之间的明度差仍保持清楚纵深。细密重复线条和小深色标记聚集在画面一部分，宽阔浅色区域给它们留出空间，建立不对称平衡。斜向退缩与逐渐柔化的对比将清晰前景细节引入朦胧远处。颗粒、轻微模糊与变暗的相纸边缘创造古旧材料表面，却没有遮蔽底层结构。反射保持低调，高光偏乳白而非刺眼纯白。整体效果耐心而有纪实感，空气氛围、重复几何以及经过权衡的明暗分割承担表现力。
theme_en: A hazy riverside avenue lined with tall old buildings and moored boats
theme_zh: 高楼与泊船相伴的朦胧河畔大道
name: Charles Marville
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
